title: Paloma Funding for Mobile Wallet Wrong-Wallet Re-Credits: Error-Resolution Tool Card
content:
**Mobile Wallet** — Paloma's own funding when money was credited to the wrong wallet.

## Situation and business effect
When the error-resolution team decides error found on a wrong-wallet notice and the customer asks for the money to be re-credited to the transfer's own wallet, Paloma funds the re-credit: one Paloma credit entry with credit reason `error_recredit`, related to the credit-sent entry that reached the wrong wallet and dated the day it is booked, which adds to the principal Paloma holds for the transfer. Once booked, Paloma's funding for the re-credit stands on the transfer's ledger.

The tool `fund_wallet_recredit_aebfda78` books that funding. Its effect, as the tool itself defines it:

- one Paloma credit entry (credit reason `error_recredit`) is booked on the given Mobile Wallet transfer, dated today and pointing at the credit that went to a wallet other than the transfer's own, funded with Paloma's own money;
- the principal Paloma holds for the transfer rises by the amount and is held for the re-credit to the transfer's own wallet;
- the transfer's status is not changed, and nothing is sent to any wallet or to the customer by this action.

## How it is invoked
`fund_wallet_recredit_aebfda78` is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it and then calls it.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `wallet_transfer_id` | the reference number of the Mobile Wallet transfer that was credited to the wrong wallet, as returned by the Mobile Wallet transfer lookup | identifier |
| `related_entry_id` | the reference number of the credit-sent money movement that reached the wrong wallet, as returned by the Mobile Wallet money-movement lookup | identifier |
| `amount_usd` | the funding Paloma puts in | USD, 2 decimal places, already rounded half up to the cent |

The tool books the values as given.

## Return
A dictionary rendered as text with `ledger_entry_id` (reference of the new Paloma credit entry), `wallet_transfer_id`, `related_entry_id` (the misdirected credit it answers), `amount_usd` (USD credited, 2 decimals), `entry_date` (YYYY-MM-DD, today) and `principal_held_usd` (USD Paloma now holds for the transfer, 2 decimals). A receipt with a `ledger_entry_id` means the funding stands.
